- History shows a price rally from ~60 in early September to ~65 by October 1st
- Then it continued higher to ~70 by October 11th
- The model forecasts are too low - particularly on the right side where prices are ~3-7 points higher than forecast

Looking at the divergence pattern:

Example 1: Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes by ~0.03 to ~7.72 points
Example 2: Similar pattern - model forecasts are below by ~0.3 to ~6.8 points
Example 3: Again, model forecasts are slightly below, with differences of ~0.2 to ~4.0 points
Example 4 (February 2024):
- History shows prices drifting lower from ~66 to ~62.5 range
- But true outcomes continue lower to ~52-53 range
- Model forecasts are also too high here, diverging by ~0.5 to ~9 points

Example 5: Similar to Example 4 - model forecasts are too high by ~0.3 to ~4.5 points
